metadata.thread_control_limit: Environment limits common BLAS/OpenMP runtimes; not a guarantee for every native library.

protocol.execution: Serial fresh worker processes; seeded order with method-position rotation.
protocol.timed: In-memory geometry repair, per-source-part layer bands, then native material assembly; intrinsic method checks included.
protocol.excluded: Module imports, source reading, warm-up, common external audit, fingerprints, export, slicer processing, and printing.
protocol.audit_policy: Full common audit on repeat 1; exact geometry fingerprints must match before applying it to later repeats.
protocol.normalization: Original per-part layer indices, original global Z origin, identical 0.001 mm Z gap and midpoint assignment.
protocol.notes: Local machine; no CPU pinning or isolation from OS/background apps. Common footprint audit is not included in primary timing.

source.defect: two uncapped vertical wall strips; top/bottom annular caps retained

settings.grid: original input part bounds, original global z0; same nominal intervals for every method
settings.gap_policy: both ends of every nominal band trimmed by 0.0005 mm, including outer boundaries
settings.assembly: old: actual group_by_color concatenation; contour: partition_materials and second extrusion with native intrinsic checks

audit.area_budget: 0.001 mm * original/reference boundary length (plus 1e-12 mm2 arithmetic slack)
audit.scope: Sampled midpoint footprints and indexed/float32 meshes; continuous 3D fidelity is not certified
audit.profile_audit: Same bounded section_profile for all methods; every bridge/contour repair recorded
